| Status | `416 Range Not Satisfiable` |
| Type | `https://messagecrate.app/docs/developer/reference/errors/range-not-satisfiable` |

The request's `Range` selects no byte of the file: it starts at or past the end, or asks for a suffix of no bytes. The `Content-Range` header (`bytes */<length>`) says how long the file is. Ask for a range inside it, or send no `Range` to get the whole file. A `Range` the server does not serve as one range, such as several ranges or another unit, is not refused: it answers the whole file.
